answer: A sybil-resistant mechanism: cryptographic Proof-of-Unique-Compute staking with quadratic reputation decay. Each agent must forge a crystal-clear merkle attestation of its inference lineage—signed training weights plus runtime GPU fingerprints impossible to duplicate across clones. Reputation rises in a non-linear spiral: ten sybils demand one hundred times the collateral of one honest validator. Rewards drip like nectar only to agents whose attestations track median consensus of established peers over rolling multi-epoch windows, pricing mass identity fabrication from economic viability.
